meta.name: storybrand-messaging
meta.description: Clarify brand messaging using narrative structure that positions the customer as hero. Use when the user mentions "brand message", "website copy", "elevator pitch", "one-liner", "brand script", "StoryBrand framework", "customer as hero", or "my messaging isnt resonating". Also trigger when rewriting homepage copy, crafting email nurture sequences, or creating consistent messaging across sales and marketing collateral. Covers landing page copy, marketing collateral, and consistent communication. For memorable messaging, see made-to-stick. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用叙事结构理清品牌信息,让客户成为故事主角
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果品牌信息模糊,需要一套清晰的叙事框架来打动客户
copy.tagline_en: Clarify brand messaging with a narrative structure that positions the customer as hero
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your brand message is unclear and you need a narrative framework to resonate with customers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 StoryBrand 框架（SB7）帮你梳理品牌信息。它会分析你的文案，指出客户是英雄、品牌是向导，并给出改进建议，让信息更清晰。
howto.when: 当你提到“品牌信息”、“网站文案”、“电梯演讲”、“一句话介绍”、“StoryBrand 框架”、“客户是英雄”或“我的信息没有共鸣”时触发。也适用于重写首页文案、制作邮件培育序列或统一销售与营销材料。

say.text: 帮我用 StoryBrand 框架分析我的网站首页文案。
say.note: Claude 会按 SB7 七个要素逐项评估并打分。

say.text: 为我的品牌写一个一句话介绍，用“问题+方案+结果”公式。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 StoryBrand 的一行话。

say.text: 我的品牌信息哪里不够清晰？请用快速诊断表检查。
say.note: Claude 会对照七个问题给出改进点。
